market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver price is currently ~$34/oz. To reach $120 by June 2026 requires a 3.5x increase in ~15 months, surpassing all-time nominal highs dramatically. This would demand an unprecedented global monetary crisis. The market's 6.8% implied probability is grossly overestimating the odds; I estimate true probability around 0.5%.
evidence_points: Silver's all-time nominal high is ~$50 in 1980; $120 is 2.4x that peak.
No serious analyst forecasts silver above $50 in the next two years.
Reaching $120 settlement price on any day requires a sustained move, not just an intraday spike.
